subject: PrivInfra procurement + IaC gate: ACME on-prem SOW and module ownership
messages:
From: Paul Sullivan <paul.sullivan@acme-analytics.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: ACME on-prem VPC deployment inquiry

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick intro in the sales call today. ACME is evaluating a private (VPC / on-prem hybrid) deployment for a subset of our ML workloads. We wanted to get an initial SOW and a sense of the IaC modules you typically deliver (Terraform/Helm/Ansible) and the CI/CD gates required for acceptance.

Key constraints from our side:
- No public egress from model hosts without approved proxy.
- Integration with our KMS (HSM-backed) for key material.
- Audit logging retention for 7 years (we'll share the formal reqs with procurement).

Can you share a draft SOW and a list of module ownership expectations so we can start procurement? Also confirm whether Redwood supports signing module artifacts and a signed bill of materials for binary artifacts.

Cheers,
Paul
Paul Sullivan
Head of Platform Engineering, Acme Analytics
[External Attachment: ACME_Initial_Reqs.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Paul Sullivan <paul.sullivan@acme-analytics.com>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: ACME on-prem VPC deployment inquiry

Paul — great to meet you earlier. Thanks for the clear list of constraints. I've attached a working SOW (ACME_SOW_v2.docx) and a tarball that contains the preview of the Terraform/Helm/Ansible modules we propose for a private deployment (tf-modules-preview.tar.gz).

High level next steps we propose:
1) Redwood to provide SOW + module map for review (attached).
2) ACME to confirm procurement path and any standard amendments.
3) Technical alignment call (networking/KMS/audit) to confirm gating criteria for CI/CD acceptance.

Quick notes on the modules:
- terraform/vpc: creates dedicated VPC, subnets (control plane, model hosts, management), and egress/proxy hooks.
- terraform/network-security: host-level networking policies, SR-IOV flags where needed for bare metal.
- helm/control-plane: control plane manifests + OPA admission policies for cluster-level constraints.
- ansible/ops: post-deploy bootstrapping, bastion hardening, KMS key binding.

For acceptance gates we typically require:
- Security review signed by Redwood security + your security lead.
- CI pipeline passing module unit tests and integration smoke tests (we'll share the test matrix).
- Procurement + legal sign-off on SOW and SLAs.

Attachments: ACME_SOW_v2.docx (draft), tf-modules-preview.tar.gz (module stubs), network-layout-v3.drawio (diagram)

Would you be available for a technical sync Thu 6/3 10am PT?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ACME_SOW_v2.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: Paul Sullivan <paul.sullivan@acme-analytics.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 13:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: ACME on-prem VPC deployment inquiry

Vanessa — thanks, received the SOW and artifacts. A few follow-ups from procurement/security side:
- We'll need an estimated cost breakdown (engineering+license+support) tied to the SOW line items.
- Is there an option for Redwood to deliver module artifacts signed with an SBOM? We require a signed SBOM for vendor code.
- Timeline: target production pilot in Q3; what's your earliest window for a pilot?

Confirm Thu 6/3 10am PT works for the tech sync — Lina and I will be there; I've looped Procurement on the thread.

Regards,
Paul
[External Attachment: ACME_Procurement_Guidelines.docx]

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: ACME SOW review + gating proposal (please review attachments)

Team — looping you in for internal alignment ahead of the Thu sync with ACME. External asked for signed SBOM and procurement cost breakdown. Key decisions we need to lock before call:

1) Module ownership: which team owns terraform/vpc and terraform/network-security on handoff? Proposal: Infra-Platform (Aditya) owns terraform modules; Security (Irene) signs off on network policies and OPA.
2) CI/CD acceptance gates: proposed minimal gates below — need confirmation:
   - unit tests (module lint + terraform fmt + helm lint)
   - integration smoke (deployed to staging with network emulation)
   - security scan (SCA + custom policy checks)
   - signed SBOM + artifact signing for all module releases
3) Networking constraints: ACME forbids direct public egress from model hosts. We must provide a validated proxy pattern and documented failure modes.

Attachments for your review: tf-modules-preview.tar.gz, network-layout-v3.drawio, ACME_SOW_v2.docx.

Please reply with: 1) owner confirmations, 2) CI job names we will require, 3) any blockers to offering SBOM+artifact signing for customer-delivered modules.

Thanks,
Vanessa

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: ACME SOW review + gating proposal (please review attachments)

Thanks Vanessa — quick notes after a surface review of the artifacts:

- Ownership: Infra-Platform (my team) will own terraform/vpc and terraform/network-security. We'll need a formal handoff checklist that includes: module interface docs, example values files, and a minimal acceptance test harness.
- SBOM/artifact signing: we can produce an SBOM (CycloneDX) and sign release artifacts via our release pipeline. We'll need to coordinate with Legal on the export/third-party signing constraints (some customers require notarization).
- CI job names (proposed):
   * infra-module-lint (tfsec + tflint + terraform fmt check)
   * infra-module-unit (unit tests + go/py module checks)
   * infra-module-integ-smoke (deploy to ephemeral staging using provided layout + network emulation)
   * infra-module-sbom-sign (generate SBOM + pgp sign artifact)
- Networking: for ACME's no-direct-egress rule, propose a hardened egress proxy (bastion + proxy cluster) and an enforced egress allowlist (applied via outbound firewall/OPA). We'll capture failure modes in the SOW (proxy outage => fallback to degraded read-only mode).

Blocking items: KMS/HSM integration requires a short security design doc from ACME describing the endpoint and auth flow. Also need clarity on bare-metal NIC offload (SR-IOV) expectations — that's in the network-layout-v3.

I'll prepare a concise handoff checklist and sample job pipeline before Thu's call.

– Aditya
Senior Engineering Manager, Infra-Platform

Subject: Re: Intro: ACME on-prem VPC deployment inquiry — next steps & SOW

Paul / Procurement team — thanks for the call earlier. Quick summary and asks so procurement can proceed: 

Summary of agreements: 
- Redwood will deliver a draft SOW (attached) that includes module list and acceptance gates.
- Infra-Platform (Aditya) will own terraform modules; Security (Irene) will sign network policy acceptance.
- Redwood will provide SBOMs and digitally sign release artifacts for module deliveries.
- Acceptance gates will include the CI jobs listed by Aditya and a security sign-off from ACME's security lead.

Procurement asks: 
1) Please confirm the primary procurement contact and whether ACME uses standard amendments or requires SOW-level redlines.
2) Confirm budget timeline — ACME mentioned targeting a Q3 pilot; confirm whether purchase order will align to that timing.
3) Please provide the KMS integration contact and the HSM endpoint doc we requested (needed for the design review).

I've attached the updated SOW (ACME_SOW_v2.docx) and included a DocuSign link for expedited signature: https://www.docusign.com/ACME-SOW-v2

Paul — looping you for final confirmation and to get procurement contact info.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
